name: comp-365
title: Article Preview Hovercard
description: A small rounded card holds an article thumbnail beside its title and a hover hint. Hovering the thumbnail opens a wider popup with the full headline, a summary, read time and last-updated date.
use: A linked thumbnail needs to preview the article before a reader commits to opening it.
avoid: Hover-only previews are inaccessible on touch devices and the popup can be clipped near a screen edge.
a11y: The link opens the card on focus, but the image alt is only 'Content' and the popup text is not tied to the trigger as a description. (keyboard: yes, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: Inside a dark rounded card, a small photo thumbnail sits left of a bold 'Building a Design System' label and a faint caption. Hovering opens a dark popup below with an upward pointer, a bold two-line headline, grey summary text and a small '8 min read · Updated 2 days ago' line.
behaves: Hovering the thumbnail opens the popup with a short delay; moving the pointer onto the popup keeps it open, and leaving fades it out. The thumbnail is a link.
customise: The image URL, headline, summary and meta line are fixed inside the file; real articles require editing them or replacing the markup.
weight: light: One small popup with text and an image; nothing runs until hover.
